title: Western Blot (tank-blot) + Antibody staining
author: Igem Dusseldorf
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8gdhts6
materials: Protein side needs to be up
Develop using ECL ( enhanced chemiluminescence) with HRP

steps.title: Prepare blotting buffer
steps.instruction: Create a blotting buffer stock and fill a tray with the solution.

substeps.instruction: Combine 100mL 10x SDS running buffer, 200mL 100% Methanol, and 700mL H20.

steps.title: Assemble blotting sandwich
steps.instruction: Construct the blotting sandwich, ensuring no bubbles are trapped between layers.

substeps.instruction: Transfer SDS gel to the blotting buffer.
Soak a sponge and place it at the base.
Soak filter paper and place it on the sponge.
Place the inverted SDS gel on top without creating bubbles.
Add a charged PVDF membrane (charged in 100% ethanol and then soaked in buffer) using forceps.
Add a soaked filter and streak out any remaining bubbles.
Add a soaked sponge on top.

steps.title: Perform protein transfer
steps.instruction: Transfer proteins from the gel to the membrane using the blotting apparatus.

substeps.instruction: Press the sandwich together and close the container.
Place the assembly in the blotting apparatus and add blotting buffer.
Run the transfer for 1 h at 100 V and 350-500 mA.

steps.title: Block the membrane
steps.instruction: Block the membrane to prevent non-specific binding.

substeps.instruction: Add 40 ml fresh TBS-BSA into an empty pipet tip box.
Place the membrane from the blotting apparatus into the solution using forceps.
Incubate overnight at 4° C with shaking at 20 rpm.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the membrane with the primary antibody.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a solution containing 50 ml 1x TBS-BSA, 100 µl Tween-20, and x µl Antibody (volume depending on affinity).
Incubate for 1 h with shaking.

steps.title: Wash the membrane
steps.instruction: Wash the membrane to remove unbound antibodies.

substeps.instruction: Wash 2 times quickly with TBST.
Wash 3 times for 10 min each with TBST.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: If using a secondary antibody, repeat the incubation and washing process.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the membrane in the secondary antibody solution.
Repeat the washing steps.
